Headline: Your accounts. Your workspace.
Subtitle: Run independent Claude Desktop profiles with access to your existing projects.
SignInHelp: Set this launcher as the CLAUDE link handler, then choose a profile when sign-in returns.
HistoryHelp: History is checked on launch. Fully quit the Claude profile before importing changes.
Ready: Ready. Select a profile to get started.
HandlerRegistered: Sign-in handler registered. Choose Claude Profiles Native for CLAUDE links in Windows settings.
DefaultAppsOpened: Select Claude Profiles Native as the default application for CLAUDE links.
HandlerRestored: Previous handler restored. If you changed the Windows default app, select Claude there again.
HistoryResult: History: {0} added, {1} updated with backups, {2} unchanged, {3} skipped. Reopen this Claude profile to refresh its list.
CallbackHelp: Select the profile where you started signing in. The sign-in link is not saved.
ErrorReadProfiles: Could not read the profile list.
ErrorProfileName: Profile names must contain 1–80 visible characters.
ErrorCallback: A valid Claude sign-in link is required.
ErrorSessionDirectory: Claude did not create its profile session directory. Check the application path and try again.
ErrorNoBackup: No previous sign-in handler was saved.
ErrorHandlerChanged: Another application changed the sign-in handler. Its setting was preserved.
ErrorReadBackup: Could not read the saved handler.
ErrorIndexTooLarge: The history record exceeds the size limit.
ErrorIndexLink: The history directory is a reparse point. Import was skipped.
HandlerDescription: Routes Claude sign-in links to a selected Desktop profile.
DetectingClaude: Looking for the installed Claude application…
ClaudeNotFound: Claude was not found automatically. Use Browse… to select Claude.exe.
